java.hint: Runs as one file with `java File.java`, so declare the class with main first.

sh.hint: A script run on its own with no arguments (one that needs arguments or other programs is a shell answer). Start with #!/bin/bash. In bc, use scale=6 or more and ^ for integer powers, rounding only when printing. Strip wc's padding (wc -l < file | tr -d ' '). Script files in shell answers follow these rules too.

cleanup: mysql -N -e 'SHOW DATABASES' | while read -r d; do case "$d" in {ns}*) mysql -e "DROP DATABASE \`$d\`";; esac; done
mysql.hint: SQL (MySQL 8; emulate unsupported features such as FULL OUTER JOIN and say so in answer). Each group starts in a fresh empty database: CREATE DATABASE and USE only when the question names a database to create, with that name. Use DELIMITER $$ for procedures and triggers, and DROP ... IF EXISTS before creating one. Show structure with DESC; end SHOW CREATE TABLE with \G. No transactions or ROLLBACK unless the question asks. Name every constraint a later statement refers to.

shell.hint: Commands typed at a terminal. A script is a files entry, never typed at the prompt or created with cat, echo or heredocs; code holds only the commands that use it (chmod +x, running it with real arguments). When a command reads input, type the input on the next lines instead of piping it. To signal a process, start it in the background, sleep 1, then use $!. Never use commands that don't return (top, watch, tail -f, editors).

dot.hint: Diagrams: ER, EER, schema, UML, flowcharts. A question that asks to draw, design or update a diagram always gets one. ER in Chen notation: entity box, weak entity peripheries=2, attribute ellipse, key attribute underlined with an HTML label, multivalued peripheries=2, derived style=dashed, relationship diamond, identifying relationship peripheries=2, cardinality as edge labels, total participation color="black:black"; EER adds a small circle labelled d or o. For ER and EER use layout=neato, overlap=false, splines=true and keep the drawing about as tall as wide. Default font. Include every attribute and key the written answers mention.

html.hint: A web page or UI: one self-contained file with CSS and JS inline.

plot.hint: Charts and graphs: Python with matplotlib that ends with plt.savefig(__file__.rsplit('.', 1)[0] + '.png').
